def comps_of(I,val):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0]); seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if I[i][j]==val and not seen[i][j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and I[a][b]==val and not seen[a][b]:
                        seen[a][b]=True; comp.append((a,b))
                        st+=[(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]
                out.append(comp)
    return out
